title: Lesson 2 Checkpoint — Articles a / an / the
description: Show what you learned about articles a / an / the. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use a, an, and the in common noun phrases.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Articles a / an / the: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which

questions.question: Complete: ___ need a pen.
questions.explanation: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which one. No article wit

questions.question: True or false: "I need a pen." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: The pen on the desk ___ blue.
questions.explanation: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which one. No article with plural g
